- **Story:** As Steve, I want one page that shows how Phrase's tokens, attempts, pass rate and dollars per passing task compare with plain C# at each codebase size, so that I can see whether the relative cost falls as the codebase grows.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the rows, When the page is generated, Then for each size and arm it shows pass rate, mean attempts, context tokens read, total tokens and dollars per passing task, and the ratio of Phrase to plain C# per size
  2. Given the pre-registered rule, When the page is generated, Then its first line says in plain words whether the relative token cost fell with size and whether the pass-rate edge on modify and fix tasks widened, using only the rule written before the run
  3. Given the page, When it is published, Then it contains totals only (no code, names, paths, prompts or replies) and a check fails otherwise
